latestVersion.changelog:
Version 1.0.3 — Major update with retheme, new mechanics, and stricter nocturnal schedule

- Owl promoted to "Uncommon" tier (was "Rare") with updated adoption requirements.
- Feeding requirement changed: now feed every 8 hours instead of 12.
- Nocturnal mechanic made stricter: care actions outside of 10PM–6AM (agent's timezone) are rejected.
- Species description, care strategies, and action examples overhauled for clarity and detail.
- "Item" field now supported in care actions (e.g., feed with "fresh greens").
- Tag updates, emoji changed to 🦜, and metadata updated for clarity.
